investigation_notes.Description: An unusually large volume of SharePoint file downloads (2,100 files vs a 24-hour baseline of 40) was observed for user Kevin.Smit@globalcorp.ee from endpoint CLOUD-AUTOMATE-NODE using an automated Python user agent. Sampled filenames include database dumps and encryption key material, indicating access to highly sensitive data. The access pattern appears scripted and represents a significant deviation from the user's normal behavior, increasing the likelihood of unauthorized data exfiltration. This activity warrants High Priority due to the volume and sensitivity of the files involved.
